parked.spanish: y echen la tierra, y habiten en ella, porque a ustedes di la tierra para heredar a ella.

findings.issue: Hiphil sequential perfect 2mp of H3423 with the land as direct object licenses taking possession of or dispossessing the land. “echen” means throw or cast, so the land is expelled.
Qal infinitive of H3423 leaves possess, seize, and inherit open. “heredar” selects inheritance.

parked.spanish: Y si no echarán a los habitantes de la tierra de delante de ustedes, y será que los que dejaren de ellos serán a espinas en ojos de ustedes y a aguijones en sus costados, y angustiarán a ustedes sobre la tierra que ustedes habitantes en ella.

findings.issue: אֲשֶׁר is the object of hiphil 2mp תּוֹתִירוּ “you leave remaining,” with מֵהֶם “from them”; “los que dejaren” makes those people the subject of dejar and drops the addressees’ hiphil act.
Unmarked “serán” repeats וְהָיָה, already rendered “será”; לְשִׂכִּים is that verb’s predicate, so the second copula does not add a concept.
אַתֶּם יֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ predicates “you dwelling in it”; bare “ustedes habitantes” names a noun and does not predicate the active participle.
